title: Mino++ (Unofficial 1.21.11 Port)
description: Play UNO in Minecraft. Sit down at an in-world table and play with friends or bot players.
body:
![Mino++ gameplay — an in-world UNO table with human and bot players](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Truhf0414/minopp-fabric-1.21.11/main/docs/gameplay-table.png)

**Play UNO in Minecraft.** Sit down at an in-world table and play with friends or bot players.

> A single-version **Fabric 1.21.11** port of [Mino++](https://github.com/zbx1425/minopp) by **zbx1425**, distributed under the original MIT license. A faithful, cleaned-up single-version fork — not a behavioral rewrite. See the [source & porting notes](https://github.com/Truhf0414/minopp-fabric-1.21.11).

## Features

- Play UNO at an in-world table block — with other players or automated (bot) players
- A config screen for the bot players (powered by YACL)
- In-game hand HUD and card interactions

![Your turn — the in-game hand HUD and the card-play prompt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Truhf0414/minopp-fabric-1.21.11/main/docs/gameplay-turn.png)

## How to play

**Controls**

- Right-click a draw pile to draw a card or to pass; right-click elsewhere to play a card
- Hold `Ctrl` while playing a card to call **Mino** — do it while you still have two cards in hand
- Forgot to call Mino while playing? Type `Mino` in chat to make up for it
- To challenge someone for not calling Mino, just **hit them**
- If the table is destroyed while you still hold cards bound to it, right-click the sky to unbind them

**Rules**

- Starting hand: **7** cards; the game opens with a non-action card
- You **may** steal a turn by playing a card identical to the previous one, and **may** stack +2 and +4
- You **may not** play a wild +4 while you still have another playable card (it's an illegal play, so there's no challenge rule)
- You **may** play an action card as your final card
- Calling Mino while you have more than 1 card in hand incurs a **2-card penalty draw**
- After drawing, you may still play another card from your hand

## Requirements

Requires **Fabric API** and **YACL** (Yet Another Config Lib) — both are listed under Dependencies.
Runs on both client and server; for multiplayer, install it (and its dependencies) on the server as well as every client.
